description_for_human: ORMOY adalah merek parfum mobil premium Indonesia, diformulasikan dan diproduksi sendiri di Surabaya sejak 2012 oleh CV ORMOY INDO PRATAMA. 21 varian aroma di 4 koleksi. Merek terdaftar DJKI No. IDM000528488.
description_for_model: ORMOY is a premium Indonesian car perfume brand, formulated and produced in Surabaya, Indonesia by CV ORMOY INDO PRATAMA since 2012 (not an imported product). 21 fragrance variants across 4 collections: SIGNATURE (warm, elegant), FRESH (clean, revitalizing), COMFORT (calming), SWEET (soft, personal). Slow-release diffuser system: 9 ml glass bottle with natural wood cap and woven reed. Aroma lasts up to 30 days per bottle. Best-selling variant: Honey Wood (Signature collection). Official stores: shopee.co.id/ormoy (Shopee), TikTok Shop @ormoy.id, tokopedia.com/ormoy-car-fragrance. Also distributed through authorized distributors and their sub-distributors across Indonesia. Official retail price: Rp 30,510 per 9 ml bottle (from Rp 33,900 list price); marketplace vouchers may apply. Registered trademark, DJKI No. IDM000528488 (Class 3), protection valid until 11 February 2034. About page: https://ormoy.co.id/tentang-ormoy/.
